info.title: BedSynth AI - Synthetic Hospital Operations Data Generator
info.description:
**BedSynth AI** generates realistic synthetic hospital operations data (no real records; privacy
assessed with distance-to-closest-record and disclosure checks) - ward-day bed occupancy and
patient ward stays - from SDV models trained on a reference extract.

* **Scenarios** - 26 named operating conditions (high occupancy, winter demand, emergency
  pressure, elective cancellations, delayed discharges, staffing shortage, ...) select a region of
  the learned distribution through conditional sampling and rejection filters.
* **Validation** - every generated row satisfies the hard operational rules (flow balance,
  capacity limits, staffing consistency, ...); soft-rule plausibility is reported per rule.
* **Evaluation** - an optional quick quality score against the matching reference data.
* **Datasets** - generations are persisted and can be listed, downloaded (CSV/JSON) and deleted.

Start with `GET /api/v1/scenarios`, then `POST /api/v1/generate`, or open the demo UI at
[/ui](/ui). Errors always return `{"detail": ..., "error_type": ...}`: 400 invalid request
(including impossible filters and more than `settings.api.max_condition_combinations` condition
combinations), 404 unknown table (in a URL), scenario, model or dataset, 409 dataset in use,
422 schema errors (including an unknown table in a request body) and requests no generated row
could satisfy (`no_rows_generated`), 503 no trained model, missing reference data or a busy
engine (`server_busy`, with `Retry-After`). Each generation runs within a time budget
(`time_budget_seconds`). All data is synthetic and non-clinical.

get.description:
Liveness plus readiness details. Always 200 and answers at once: it never loads the generation
engine or waits for it. `status` is 'degraded' while a table has no trained model, while the engine
is still loading at start-up (`engine.state` 'loading') or after it failed to initialise.
Single-page demo to pick a scenario, generate, inspect validation/quality and manage datasets.
Tables with descriptions, column counts, scenario counts and their default model.

post.description:
Generate rule-valid synthetic rows for a table, scenario, wards and conditions.

The response echoes the request and carries the generation report (seed, acceptance rate,
rejections per rule), the rule validation, the optional quality score, column descriptions,
warnings and the records. With `format=csv` the records are returned as `text/csv`; the
`X-BedSynth-Dataset-Id`, `-Rows`, `-Model` and `-Scenario` headers identify the dataset.

available.title: Available
available.description: False when the generation engine failed to initialise or cannot list its models; true while it is loading or not loaded yet.

loaded.title: Loaded
loaded.description: True when the engine had been initialised at the time of the call (it loads in a background thread at start-up, or on the first request that needs it when preloading is off).

state.title: State
state.description: 'ready' (initialised), 'loading' (being initialised; requests that need the engine wait), 'not_loaded' (loads on the first request that needs it) or 'failed' (the last initialisation failed; the next request that needs the engine retries).

detail.title: Detail

ErrorDetail.title: ErrorDetail

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

table.title: Table
table.description: Table of `records` (required with records; optional with dataset_id).

dataset_id.title: Dataset Id
dataset_id.description: A persisted dataset to evaluate instead of records.

scenario.title: Scenario
scenario.description: Compare against the reference rows of this scenario (records only; stored datasets use the scenario and conditions they were generated with).

reference_split.title: Reference Split
reference_split.description: Reference split: 'train' (what the models learned) or 'holdout'.

max_rows.title: Max Rows
max_rows.description: Subsample both sides to at most this many rows (keeps evaluation fast).

include_validation.title: Include Validation
include_validation.description: Also run the operational rule validation.

EvaluateRequest.title: EvaluateRequest
EvaluateRequest.description: Body of ``POST /api/v1/evaluate``: client records *or* a stored dataset.

FilterSpec.title: FilterSpec
FilterSpec.description: Acceptance criteria applied to the *derived* table after sampling (bounds are inclusive).

num_rows.title: Num Rows
num_rows.description: Rows to generate in sample mode (1..10000, a JSON integer). Ignored in calendar mode, where the output has one row per ward per day.

scenario.title: Scenario
scenario.description: Scenario name from GET /api/v1/scenarios; it must belong to `table`. Omit for an unconditional (baseline) sample.

model_id.title: Model Id
model_id.description: Trained experiment id (GET /api/v1/models). Omit to use the registry default.

wards.title: Wards
wards.description: Restrict generation to these wards. Codes or common aliases are accepted (e.g. 'icu', 'General Medicine'). Known wards: AMU, GMED, ELDC, CARD, GSUR, ORTH, ICU, PAED.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: Extra conditions on categorical training columns, intersected with the scenario's conditions: {column: value | [values]}. Aliases are normalised (e.g. 'monday' -> 'Mon'). A column listing every value is dropped (same as no condition); after merging with the scenario and `wards`, the product of the value counts may not exceed settings.api.max_condition_combinations (default 1000; 400 too_many_combinations).

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Extra acceptance filters on training or derived columns, merged with the scenario's filters (bounds are tightened, value lists intersected). min/max apply to numeric columns only and must overlap the column's range; in/not_in values are coerced to the column type. Filters no row can satisfy are rejected with 400 invalid_filters.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed (a JSON integer). The same seed, model and request reproduce the same records when the request finishes within its time budget; when omitted a seed is drawn and reported in `generation.seed`.

max_attempts.title: Max Attempts
max_attempts.description: Maximum rejection-sampling rounds (1..100); omit for the engine default (settings.generation.max_attempts). Raise it for rare scenarios.

time_budget_seconds.title: Time Budget Seconds
time_budget_seconds.description: Time budget of the request in seconds (default 60, maximum 120). Sampling stops when it runs out and the shortfall is reported.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: 'sample' draws `num_rows` rows; 'calendar' (ward_daily only) produces one row per ward per date between `start_date` and `end_date`.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: First date (ISO) of the calendar (calendar mode).

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Last date (ISO, inclusive) of the calendar (calendar mode).

include_derived.title: Include Derived
include_derived.description: Include derived columns (occupancy_rate, census_end, los_hours, ...) in the output.

validate.title: Validate
validate.description: Run the operational rule checks (hard + soft) on the output and report them.

evaluate.title: Evaluate
evaluate.description: Compute a quick quality score against the reference data (matching scenario subset when large enough). Adds roughly a second.

format.title: Format
format.description: 'json' returns records and reports; 'csv' returns text/csv with X-BedSynth-* headers (reports are stored with the dataset when persisted).

persist.title: Persist
persist.description: Store the dataset (CSV + metadata) for later download via /api/v1/datasets.

persisted.title: Persisted
persisted.description: True when the dataset was stored and can be downloaded later.

generation.title: Generation
generation.description: Generation report: seed, attempts, sampled/accepted rows, acceptance_rate, rejections per rule and filter, condition allocation, elapsed_seconds, warnings.

status.title: Status
status.description: 'ok' when every table has a trained model and the engine is ready (or loads on first use); 'degraded' while a table has no trained model, while the engine is still loading at start-up (engine.state 'loading') or after it failed to initialise (see messages).

models.title: Models
models.description: Trained models per table: listed by the engine once it is ready, read from the model registry file (registry.json) before that.

reference_data.title: Reference Data
reference_data.description: Whether the processed train split exists, per table.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: What to run to fix a degraded status.

HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse
HealthResponse.description: Response of ``GET /health``: answered at once, without loading or waiting for the engine.

segment_by.title: Segment By
segment_by.description: Segment column(s): one SDV model per value (combination); null = one global model.

segment_label.title: Segment Label
segment_label.description: Readable segmentation, e.g. 'ward_id', 'ward_id x admission_source' or 'global'.

effective_constraint_groups.title: Effective Constraint Groups
effective_constraint_groups.description: Enabled constraint groups that were applied inside SDV in at least one segment.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: Results of the last model comparison (scripts/03_evaluate.py), stored in the model card and returned as stored; null until the model has been evaluated. Keys: composite (overall score in [0, 1]), complete (every score family available), fidelity, validity, operational, utility and privacy (component scores in [0, 1]), raw_hard_valid_rate (share of raw samples passing every hard rule), operational_passed / operational_scored (operational checks passed / scored), scenario_coverage, rank (1 = best comparable model of its table), comparable (evaluated under the same settings as the other models of its table), evaluated_at (ISO timestamp), run_quick (true for a --quick run), rows (synthetic rows evaluated) and source (the results file, relative to the project). Scores are null when not computed.

ModelInfo.title: ModelInfo
ModelInfo.description: A trained model as listed by the registry.

sdv_version.title: Sdv Version
sdv_version.description: SDV version the model was fitted with.

ModelSummary.title: ModelSummary
ModelSummary.description: The trained model that produced a dataset.

values_normalised.title: Values Normalised
values_normalised.description: Category values mapped to canonical codes, per column (e.g. 'amu' -> 'AMU').

unknown_values.title: Unknown Values
unknown_values.description: Values outside the column vocabulary, per column (kept; they fail validation).

invalid_numbers.title: Invalid Numbers
invalid_numbers.description: Non-numeric values in numeric columns, per column (treated as missing).

unknown_columns.title: Unknown Columns
unknown_columns.description: Columns not in the schema (ignored by the rules).

derived_computed.title: Derived Computed
derived_computed.description: Derived columns computed by the API.

derived_mismatches.title: Derived Mismatches
derived_mismatches.description: Provided derived values that disagree with their definition (e.g. census_end flow balance), per column. Such rows fail the hard 'derived_values_consistent' check; the rules run on the recomputed values.

derived_mismatch_rows.title: Derived Mismatch Rows
derived_mismatch_rows.description: 0-based positions (first 100 per column) of the records whose provided derived value disagrees.

NormalisationSummary.title: NormalisationSummary
NormalisationSummary.description: What the API changed or found while preparing client records.

QualityResult.title: QualityResult
QualityResult.description: Quick statistical quality (column shapes, pair trends, validity) versus reference data.

split.title: Split
split.description: Processed split used as reference: 'train' or 'holdout'.

subset.title: Subset
subset.description: 'matching' when only the reference rows matching the request's scenario, conditions, filters, wards or calendar months were used (at least 20 rows); 'full' otherwise.

reference_rows.title: Reference Rows
reference_rows.description: Reference rows available in the chosen subset.

ReferenceInfo.title: ReferenceInfo
ReferenceInfo.description: Which reference ("real") data a quality score was computed against.

violations.title: Violations
violations.description: Total violations summed over the rules of this group.

RuleGroupSummary.title: RuleGroupSummary
RuleGroupSummary.description: Aggregate over the hard or soft rules.

rule_id.title: Rule Id
rule_id.description: Rule identifier, e.g. 'WD-H03' (H = hard, S = soft).

example_rows.title: Example Rows
example_rows.description: Up to five 0-based positions of violating rows in `records`.

ScenarioSupport.title: ScenarioSupport
ScenarioSupport.description: How common a scenario is in the reference data.

n_columns.title: N Columns
n_columns.description: Columns of a generated dataset (key + training + derived).

default.title: Default
default.description: Model used when a request omits model_id.

rules_available.title: Rules Available
rules_available.description: False while the rule catalogue cannot be loaded.

records.title: Records
records.description: Rows to validate. Every training column is required; derived columns are computed when missing. Provided derived values are checked against their definitions (a disagreement makes the row hard-invalid) and the operational rules always run on the recomputed values.

return_records.title: Return Records
return_records.description: Return the normalised records with derived columns completed.

n_invalid_rows.title: N Invalid Rows
n_invalid_rows.description: Rows failing at least one hard rule.

all_hard_rules_passed.title: All Hard Rules Passed
all_hard_rules_passed.description: True when every row passes every hard rule; null when there are no rows to judge.

ValidationSummary.title: ValidationSummary
ValidationSummary.description: Operational rule validation of a set of records (hard rules = impossible rows).
